title: Markov Decision Processes (MDPs)
text: MDP2 package R package solving Markov decision processes (MDPs) discrete time-steps, states actions. traditional MDPs (Puterman 1994), semi-Markov decision processes (semi-MDPs) (Tijms 2003) hierarchical-MDPs (HMDPs) (Kristensen Jørgensen 2000) can solved finite infinite time-horizon. Building solving MDP done two steps. First, MDP built saved set binary files. Next, load MDP memory binary files apply various algorithms model. package implement well-known algorithms policy iteration value iteration different criteria e.g. average reward per time unit expected total discounted reward. model stored using underlying data structure based state-expanded directed hypergraph MDP (Nielsen Kristensen (2006)) implemented C++ fast running times.

Call building model. add_action(label = NULL, s_idx, weights, prob, ...): adds action. s_idx id state defining action. weights must vector action weights. prob matrix (s_idx, pr) first column contains id transition state; see description actionIdx.bin , scope assumed 3. ... currently ignored. end_action(): ends action. close_writer(): closes writer. Call model description finished. Five binary files created: actionIdx.bin: integers defining actions format s_idx scope idx scope idx scope idx -1 s_idx scope idx scope idx -1 s_idx scope -1 .... s_idx corresponds index line number stateIdx.bin, starting 0. following (scope, idx) pairs indicate possible transitions. Scope can take four values: 2: transition child process, stage zero child process. 1: transition next stage current process. 0: transition next stage father process. 3: transition state specified state s_idx. example, scope = 1 idx = 2, transition state number 3 next stage current process. scope = 3 idx = 5, transition state specified line 6 stateIdxLbl.bin. useful considering shared child processes. actionIdxLbl.bin: character data format a_idx label a_idx label .... a_idx corresponds index line number actionIdx.bin, starting 0. delimiter used. actionWeight.bin: doubles containing action weights format "c1 c2 c3 c1 c2 c3 ...", assuming three weights action. actionWeightLbl.bin: character data containing weight labels format label1 label2 label3, assuming three weights action. transProb.bin: doubles containing transition probabilities defined actionIdx.bin. format "p1 p2 p3 -1 p1 -1 p1 p2 -1 ...". -1 indicates new action considered.

text: returned writer exposes functions: set_weights(labels, ...): sets labels weights used actions. labels vector label names. ... currently ignored. Call building model. process(): starts (sub)process. may also used specify traditional MDP using matrices MDPtoolbox style. style, p list matrices, one per action, size $S x S$ $S$ number states. used row must sum one, entries row must zero unused. r matrix size $S x $, $$ number actions, d matrix size $S x $ durations. d omitted, durations assumed 1. end_process(): ends (sub)process. stage(label = NULL): starts stage. label currently unused binary format. end_stage(): ends stage. state(label = NULL): starts state returns, invisibly, state id. id can later referenced scope 3. end_state(): ends state. action(scope = NULL, id = NULL, pr = NULL, prob = NULL, weights, trans_weights = NULL, label = NULL, end = FALSE, ...): starts action. weights must vector action weights. trans_weights must contain transition weights ordered transition, transition weight labels first transition followed labels second transition, . Transition probabilities can entered two ways: prob contains triples (scope, id, pr). id pr vectors equal length. scope omitted, scopes default 1. See description actionIdx.bin . end = TRUE, calling end_action() necessary. ... currently ignored. end_action(): ends action. use end = TRUE used action specified. include_process(prefix, label = NULL, weights, prob, term_states, trans_weights = NULL): includes external process. External processes loaded memory needed, helps large models. prefix external process prefix. weights must vector action weights, prob must contain triples (scope, idx, pr); see description actionIdx.bin . term_states must specify number states last stage external process. Inside include_process ... end_include_process block, must specify father jump actions last stage external process. external process represented first last stage together jump actions. function returns, invisibly, state ids first stage external process, can later referenced scope 3. end_include_process(): ends include_process block. close_writer(): closes writer. Call model description finished. Ten binary files created: stateIdx.bin: integers defining states format "n0 s0 -1 n0 s0 a0 n1 s1 -1 n0 s0 a0 n1 s1 a1 n2 s2 -1 n0 s0 ...". -1 indicates new state considered. stateIdxLbl.bin: character data format s_idx label s_idx label .... s_idx corresponds index line number stateIdxLbl.bin, starting 0. delimiter used. actionIdx.bin: integers defining actions format s_idx scope idx scope idx scope idx -1 s_idx scope idx scope idx -1 s_idx scope -1 .... s_idx corresponds index line number stateIdx.bin, starting 0. following (scope, idx) pairs indicate possible transitions. Scope can take four values: 2: transition child process, stage zero child process. 1: transition next stage current process. 0: transition next stage father process. 3: transition state specified state s_idx. example, scope = 1 idx = 2, transition state number 3 next stage current process. scope = 3 idx = 5, transition state specified line 6 stateIdxLbl.bin. useful considering shared child processes. actionIdxLbl.bin: character data format a_idx label a_idx label .... a_idx corresponds index line number actionIdx.bin, starting 0. delimiter used. actionWeight.bin: doubles containing action weights format "c1 c2 c3 c1 c2 c3 ...", assuming three weights action. actionWeightLbl.bin: character data containing weight labels format label1 label2 label3, assuming three weights action. transProb.bin: doubles containing transition probabilities defined actionIdx.bin. format "p1 p2 p3 -1 p1 -1 p1 p2 -1 ...". -1 indicates new action considered. externalProcesses.bin: character data containing links external processes format stage_str prefix stage_str prefix .... stage_str corresponds stage index, example n0 s0 a0 n1, stage corresponding first stage external process, prefix external process prefix. delimiter used. transWeight.bin: doubles containing transition weights format "t11 t12 t21 t22 -1 ...", assuming two transition weights transition two transitions first action. transWeightLbl.bin: character data containing transition weight labels.

code: ## Set working dir wd <- setwd(system.file("models", package = "MDP2"))  #### A finite-horizon replacement problem #### mdp<-load_mdp("machine1_") #> Read binary files (0.000191431 sec.) #> Build the HMDP (3.7415e-05 sec.) #> Checking MDP and found no errors (3.435e-06 sec.) plot(mdp)  plot(mdp, action_color = "label")  # colors based on labels  plot(mdp, trans_labels = "state")  # label transitions with target state labels  plot(mdp, trans_labels = "prob")  # label transitions with transition probabilities  plot(mdp, action_color = "label", state_label = "s_id|label")  # state labels are 's_id | label'  plot(mdp, state_label = "s_idx|label", radx = 0.01)  # adjust radx in states  plot(mdp, state_label = "label", action_w_label = "none", action_label = "label",       trans_labels = "s_id", radx = 0.01)   scrapValues <- c(30, 10, 5, 0)  # scrap values (the values of the 4 states at stage 4) run_value_ite(mdp, "Net reward" , term_values = scrapValues) #> Run value iteration with epsilon = 0 at most 1 time(s) #> using weight 'Net reward' under expected-weight Bellman operator. #>  Finished. Cpu time 8.934e-06 sec. plot(mdp, action_color = "policy")  # highlight optimal policy  plot(mdp, actions_visible = "policy", state_label = "weight")  # show only optimal policy    #### An infinite-horizon maintenance problem #### mdp<-load_mdp("hct611-1_") #> Read binary files (0.000166024 sec.) #> Build the HMDP (2.7811e-05 sec.) #> Checking MDP and found no errors (1.171e-06 sec.) plot(mdp)  # plot the first two stages  plot(mdp, action_color = "label")  # colors based on labels  plot(mdp, action_color = "label", state_label = "s_id|label")  # state labels are 's_id | label'  run_policy_ite_ave(mdp,"Net reward","Duration") #> Run policy iteration under average expected-weight Bellman operator using  #> weight 'Net reward' over 'Duration'. Iterations (g):  #> 1 (-0.512821) 2 (-0.446154) 3 (-0.43379) 4 (-0.43379) finished. Cpu time: 1.171e-06 sec. #> [1] -0.43379 plot(mdp, action_color = "policy")  # highlight optimal policy  plot(mdp, actions_visible = "policy")  # show only optimal policy    #### An infinite-horizon hierarchical replacement problem #### library(magrittr) mdp<-load_mdp("cow_") #> Read binary files (0.000223318 sec.) #> Build the HMDP (0.000177751 sec.) #> Checking MDP and found no errors (2.364e-06 sec.) hgf <- get_hypergraph(mdp) # modify labels dat <- hgf$nodes %>%     dplyr::mutate(label = dplyr::case_when(       label == "Low yield" ~ "L",       label == "Avg yield" ~ "A",       label == "High yield" ~ "H",       label == "Dummy" ~ "D",       label == "Bad genetic level" ~ "Bad",       label == "Avg genetic level" ~ "Avg",       label == "Good genetic level" ~ "Good",       TRUE ~ "Error"    )) # assign nodes to grid ids dat$g_id[1:3]<-85:87 dat$g_id[43:45]<-1:3 get_g_id<-function(process,stage,state) {    if (process==0) start=18    if (process==1) start=22    if (process==2) start=26    return(start + 14 * stage + state) } idx<-43 for (process in 0:2)    for (stage in 0:4)       for (state in 0:2) {          if (stage==0 & state>0) break          idx<-idx-1          #cat(idx,process,stage,state,get_g_id(process,stage,state),"\n")          dat$g_id[idx]<-get_g_id(process,stage,state)       } hgf$nodes <- dat # modify labels dat <- hgf$hyperarcs %>%     dplyr::mutate(label = dplyr::case_when(       label == "Replace" ~ "R",       label == "Keep" ~ "K",       label == "Dummy" ~ "D",       TRUE ~ "Error"    ),    col = dplyr::case_when(       label == "R" ~ "deepskyblue3",       label == "K" ~ "darkorange1",       label == "D" ~ "black",       TRUE ~ "Error"    ),    lwd = 0.5,    label = ""    )  hgf$hyperarcs <- dat # plot hypergraph oldpar <- par(mai = c(0, 0, 0, 0)) plot_hypergraph(grid_dim = c(14, 7), hgf, cex = 0.8, radx = 0.02, rady = 0.03)  par(oldpar)   ## text: mdp MDP loaded using load_mdp(). w label weight calculate RPO . i_a action index calculate RPO respect (size s_id). s_id Vector id's states want retrieve. criterion Bellman operator shortcut. expected use expected weights, discount use discounted expected weights, average use average expected weights. dur label duration/time discount rates can calculated. rate interest rate. rate_base time-horizon rate valid . discount_factor discount rate one time unit. specified rate rate_base used calculate discount rate. g optimal gain (g) calculated (used criterion = "average"). objective Optimize maximizing ("max") minimizing ("min") Bellman value. discount_method Either 'continuous' 'discrete', corresponding discount factor exp(-rate/rate_base) 1/(1 + rate/rate_base), respectively. used discount_factor NULL. state_str Output state string.

title: Function for writing an HMDP model to a hmp file (XML). The function define sub-functions which can be used to define an HMDP model stored in a hmp file. — hmp_mdp_writer
text: returned writer exposes functions: set_weights(labels, duration): sets labels weights used actions. labels vector label names. duration identifies label corresponds duration time. example, first entry labels time, duration = 1. Call building model. set_trans_weights(labels): sets labels transition-level weights. process(): starts (sub)process. end_process(): ends (sub)process. stage(label = NULL): starts stage. end_stage(): ends stage. state(label = NULL): starts state returns state index s_idx. end_state(): ends state. action(label = NULL, weights, prob, states_next = NULL, trans_weights = NULL): starts action. weights must vector action weights, prob must contain triples (scope, idx, pr). scope can take three values: 0: transition next stage father process. 1: transition next stage current process. 2: transition child process, stage zero child process. idx value denotes index state stage considered. example, scope = 1 idx = 2, transition state number 3 next stage current process, counting zero. scope = 3 supported hmp file format. states_next number states next stage process needed transition father. end_action(): ends action. close_writer(): closes writer. Call model description finished.

title: Plot parts of the state expanded hypergraph. — plot_hypergraph
text: hgf list hypergraph containing two data frames, normally found using get_hypergraph(). data frame nodes must columns: s_id (state id), g_id (grid id) label (node label). data frame hyperarcs must columns s_id (head node), trans (list-column tail node ids), pr (list-column transition probabilities), action_weights (list-column action weights), trans_weights (list-column transition--weight matrices), a_idx (action index), label (action label), lwd (hyperarc line width), lty (hyperarc line type) col (hyperarc color). grid_dim 2-dim vector (rows, cols) representing size grid. show_grid true show grid points (good debugging). radx Horizontal radius box. rady Vertical radius box. cex Relative size text. mar_x Horizontal margin. mar_y Vertical margin. draw_border TRUE, draw border around plot region report outside inside padding (good debugging). action_offset Distance used separate actions start trans states. Set 0 draw overlapping actions. trans_labels Transition-label mode. "none" draws transition labels (default); "custom" draws values optional trans_labels list-column hgf$hyperarcs; otherwise use |-separated combination "label", "s_id", "prob", "weights", example "prob|weights". older "state" spelling treated "label". trans_label_cex Relative size transition-label text. trans_label_adj Position adjustment passed textempty() transition labels, drawn middle split--transition branch. state_label plot states. "custom" uses state_label column hgf$nodes; otherwise use |-separated combination "label" (state label, default), "s_id" (state id), "s_idx" (stage-based state index), "weight" (optimal weight state). action_label plot near split. One "none", "custom" (uses action_label column hgf$hyperarcs), |-separated combination "label" (action label, default) "a_idx". action_w_label plot start state split. One "none" (default), "weight", "custom" (uses action_w_label column hgf$hyperarcs). action_color Action coloring scheme. Default "" uses black lines. "label" uses different colors based action labels. "policy" highlights current policy. actions_visible Action visibility mode. "" (default) shows actions. "policy" shows actions current policy. connected_to Optional vector state ids. supplied, plot states reachable states following visible hyperarcs forward, trim hyperarcs transition-level data remaining states. recalc_grid TRUE connected_to supplied, recalculate grid visible nodes. Nodes keep original columns, visible nodes within column placed consecutively top number grid rows reduced maximum number visible nodes column. mdp MDP model. Required state_label contains "weight", action_color = "policy", actions_visible = "policy". ... Graphical parameters passed textempty.
